why_live_data: Sleepy Owl's founder found his top-selling SKU missing on a quick-commerce app and said 'this is a gap that I would never be able to identify at a pin code level data', because 'quick-commerce operates at the locality level', so without live data it cannot see locality-level availability of its own SKUs.
